replaces.idea: A standing brass coin-sorter box with slotted sieve plates that only let permitted syscall tokens drop through.
A stone-and-brass customs inspection counter with a recessed pass-through tray for validating user-space parcels.
A brass periscope mounted on a tripod floor stand, angled to peer into another process's workspace.
A heavy brass keyring hanging from a wall peg, holding three differently notched capability keys.
A wall-mounted numbered file-descriptor ticket dispenser with a paper ticket stub sticking out of the slot.
A curved brass pneumatic message tube mounted on wall brackets, bypassing the main gatehouse queue.

new.name: Syscall Sieve
new.depicts: A standing brass coin-sorter box on four short feet, with an angled top hopper and three slotted sieve plates visible through a front cutout.
new.focal: The stepped brass sieve plates inside the front cutout

new.name: Uaccess Inspection Desk
new.depicts: A wide stone-and-brass customs counter grounded on a plinth, with a recessed pass-through tray in the middle and an upright inspection lamp on the left.
new.focal: The glowing brass pass-through tray in the center

new.name: Ptrace Periscope
new.depicts: A tall brass periscope tube mounted on a heavy tripod floor stand, with a hooded eyepiece at the bottom and an angled mirror hood at the top.
new.focal: The gleaming angled mirror hood at the top

new.name: Capability Keyring
new.depicts: A heavy brass ring hanging from a small wall-mounted peg, holding three differently notched metal keys.
new.focal: The notched teeth of the three keys

new.name: FD Ticket Dispenser
new.depicts: A wall-mounted curved metal ticket dispenser with a bright paper ticket stub sticking out of the bottom slot.

new.name: vDSO Pneumatic Tube
new.depicts: A curved brass pneumatic tube mounted on two wall brackets, with a clear glass capsule chamber in the middle.
new.focal: The glowing capsule inside the middle chamber

new.name: VFS Mount Signpost
new.depicts: A short iron post planted in a round floor base, topped by two riveted metal directional sign blades pointing opposite ways.

new.name: Ioctl Valve Manifold
new.depicts: A compact cast-iron pipe manifold bolted to the floor, with three small brass handwheel valves in a row.
